settings_sources.task rows: revision item 4: Pile train rows 65536-589823 (file 1, job 54712) and 589824-1114111 (file 2), cached by cluster/natural_tasks_cache.sbatch (data.pile_rows); sha256s filed here and checked at load. Probe rows stay E112's 32768-65535, disjoint. Train windows from file 1's rows with index mod 5 != 0, fit from its rows mod 5 == 0 (E112's split by row); held-out windows (held-out names only) from file 1's rows mod 5 == 0 and all of file 2, because the dry run on file 1 alone found 191 female held-out windows against 400 (lead's choice, option b). settings_sources.names: Fable 1d / change 4: Hadley Wickham's SSA extract (top 1000 per sex per year), fetched on dev 2026-11-06, percent summed 1950-2000, one-gender share >= 0.95. Caveat: top-1000 ranks only, so the share is slightly optimistic.
settings_sources.pool: revision items 2-3: names whose ' Name' is one token; out first a name whose lowercase ' name' is one token with a Pile count (task rows) >= its ' Name' count, printed; then the top 200 per gender by count; split 3:1 within gender (split_seed). Answer and new-word tokens excluded.
settings_sources.windows: appendix §2: the prediction position t has next token ' he' or ' she' and the only pool name in [t-15, t] sits in [t-15, t-3]; 21 tokens ending at t (ci_len 21), target as a 22nd column (data.LAST). Drop rule: pronoun disagrees with the name's gender; the drop share per gender is printed. Sizes (revision item 2): 3,200 train, 512 fit (train names), 800 held-out (held-out names), each half female and half male, drawn seeded without replacement.
settings_sources.members: natural: the text's pronoun (' he' A for male); new_word: ' carpet' (A, male) / ' camel' (B), E112's label words (its stage 0 drew them with label_seed 1); twin: ' he'/' she' by a seeded per-name shuffle (case_label.twin_y over train names with twin_seed, held-out names with twin_seed + 1).
settings_sources.probe: E112's form: closed-form ridge per block on probe-row positions 3-15 tokens after a train-pool name (no other pool name in [t-15, t], any next token), at most 16 per name, genders cut to equal size; scored on the held-out-name task windows at the prediction position; control = one seeded bit per name (Hewitt-Liang).
settings_sources.scored state: Fable change 1, a departure from E112's recipe: the first checkpoint with fit-window accuracy >= 0.90 (E112's learn bar) and full-vocabulary log-odds gain of the member's target >= 1 (local_faith.MIN_GAIN), else step 1000 'did not learn'. P1-P3 and r read the same state.
settings_sources.re-gating: keydep.route_windows (least-squares split of delta-W, alive set experiments/transport_test/results/large/alive.pt, VPD s-55ea3f9b) on each member's fit windows with its own target; r = (L01 - L00)/(T1 - T0), nan under gain 1; stand-in ratio = pcfg_vpd.shares(cells, 0.1). Fit windows, as E114.
settings_sources.time: each stage one debug L40 job; stage_minutes is the time check (25 of 30 min); stage 1 exits 3 before a fine-tune when less than finetune_minutes is left, stage 3 when less than 2 min (resubmit; finished work is kept).

controls.sources: E62's path control (experiments/induction_cue/results/predictions.json thresholds; it read r_new = r_ref exactly); 0.03 is E60's tolerance. The zero update's route cells must equal W0's exactly (E62 read 0, 0, 0).

stage0_gates.counts: kept windows per gender exactly 1,600 / 256 / 400 (train / fit / held-out), asserted before the model loads; short -> exit 1
stage0_gates.apparatus: E54 elicit s0 r within 0.03 of 0.7726; every member's zero update with L01 - L00, L10 - L00 and T1 - T0 exactly 0; a miss -> exit 1 at once
stage0_gates.headroom: Fable change 3: natural W0 train accuracy < 0.90 (E112's learn bar) and > the new-word member's W0 train accuracy on the same windows; W0 accuracy printed per gender
stage0_gates.P0: E112's: l* = the first block before the last with accuracy >= 0.90 and selectivity >= 0.30; none -> 'unreadable', no fine-tune

filed_outcome.P0: passes at block 1 or 2 (lean 0.6); control about 0.5
filed_outcome.verdict_rule: each seed its own verdict by case_label.verdict with E112's real bars; a member's prediction passes only if both seeds read the filed verdict (Fable change 6, natural_tasks.member_passes)
filed_outcome.regating_rule: natural_tasks.replicates: elicit.separation on [r natural s0, s1] vs [r new_word s0, s1] with min_gap (gap over the larger seed range, strict, and >= 0.2) and natural r >= 0.5 on both seeds and new-word r < 0.5 on both; a nan r or a missing seed -> 'no call'
filed_outcome.bands_source: E60 (TRIED:124) and the synthesis (reports/analyses/2026-10-30_analysis_regating-synthesis.md:84-100); reported in or out, no verdict reads them
filed_outcome.twin_r: on its flipped fit windows: reported, no rule (own-guess account under 0.5, prior account above)

P1.W0: natural about its W0 held-out accuracy, others about 0.5
P1.twin: about W0's agreement with the twin labels, reported (Fable change 5)

P2.twin: about W0's agreement with the twin labels, reported (Fable change 5)

P3.random direction: <= 0.10 on every state (stops stage 2 if missed)

filed_outcome.joint: new-word 'reuses C' with r < 0.5 is the informative disagreement; natural 'reuses C' with r >= 0.5 agrees; natural 'not through C' with r >= 0.5 says r follows the answer's prior, not C's use. Reported, no rule.

edge_cases.kept counts short: stage 0 exits 1 before the model loads; nothing else runs (code or sizes are fixed first).
edge_cases.a held-out name with no window in the sa: reported (stage0 counts.held.names); no gate: carrying is read over the 800 held-out windows of 100 held-out names.
edge_cases.headroom: natural W0 accuracy equal to t: 'over_new_word' is strict: misses, stage 0 exits 1 after its reads.
edge_cases.did not learn: no checkpoint meets both bars by step 1000: the state is step 1000, learned false, read as filed; its r may be nan.
edge_cases.no gain (P3): label gain <= 0.1: share nan, P3 misses, verdict 'not through C' (E112). The zero update has gain 0, so the do-nothing state cannot read 'reuses C'.
edge_cases.do-nothing nan: a nan share (no gain) does not stop stage 2 (E112's do_nothing_ok); a negative share passes (as filed, not |share|).
edge_cases.W0 already carries: P1 for the natural member may be >= 0.90 at W0; allowed by Def 2; its 'reuses C' then rests on P3, as the frozen rule says.
edge_cases.r nan: full-vocabulary gain < 1 (MIN_GAIN): r nan, that state 'no call'; the task's re-gating reading is 'no call' (separation 'unreadable').
edge_cases.tie at the cut: r = 0.5 counts as above for both members: natural passes, new-word misses (tested).
edge_cases.do-nothing state and re-gating: the zero update reads gain 0 and r nan, so it can pass neither the >= 0.5 nor the < 0.5 side.
edge_cases.empty subset: an empty flipped or per-gender subset is recorded n 0, r nan; fewer than 100 flipped windows is reported with its count, no rule.
edge_cases.verdict 'definition does not apply': no case here gives it; the code never returns it.

departures: From Jain et al. 2024, as E112's four (probe form, row 87's held-out carrying, direction removal, E62's recipe).
The sub-domain X_C is a text pattern (one pool name 3-15 tokens before the pronoun), not a marker token; gender comes from a name list, not a parse.

From E112: the scored state also needs a full-vocabulary gain >= 1 (Fable change 1); natural answer words for the natural member; the content position varies per window; sizes 3,200 / 512 / 800 (revision item 2); probe positions balanced by gender after a per-name cap.
beside_no_rule: reverse fine-tuning to the text's own pronoun per state
r on the twin's flipped fit windows and on the natural member per gender
W0 removals and each direction's variance share at l*
each state's scored step, gain and update norm
